|lore=Elegant sword of pure energy. “This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or as random as a blaster.” A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.
|game_text=Deploy on Mace or Yoda. [Coruscant] sites may not cancel Force drain bonuses. May add 1 to a Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw 2 destiny (3 if on Yoda and defending). Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

|notes=The recovered original Players Committee sheet is linked from the [[Jedi Lightsaber (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original 2005)|2005 publication]]. The remaster narrows deployment to Mace or Yoda, changes the drain bonus protection, removes the stated cumulative bonus and removes the immediate loss for a droid hit. The free target and variable destiny remain. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=94 Period rule or ruling].
